entries: **Antigravity can now auto-start its next 5-hour session.** A new opt-in menu toggle watches fresh, non-mock agy quota results and, when the selected model group's session is fully reset with no countdown running, dispatches one background `agy -p ok --model 'Gemini 3.5 Flash (Low)'`. It is off by default, self-throttles for five hours, uses only the local agy CLI, and shows the same Mac sleep warning as the Claude window keeper when enabled.

title.zh-TW: 下一個五小時工作階段可自動接棒
title.en: Your next five-hour session can start itself

body.zh-TW: 你剛用完 Antigravity 的五小時工作階段（session，一段可使用的固定時段），不想守著倒數等下一輪，現在可以在選單手動開啟自動接棒。它會查看最新、非模擬的 agy 額度結果；只有所選模型群組已完全重設且沒有倒數時，才在背景執行一次本機 agy CLI（命令列工具）的指定指令來開啟下一段。這個選項預設關閉，開過一次後五小時內不會重複觸發，也只使用你電腦上的 agy CLI。像接力賽交棒：跑者真的回到起跑線、計時器歸零才交棒，不會提早衝出去；開啟時也會顯示和 Claude 視窗守護功能相同的 Mac 睡眠提醒。
body.en: Finished an Antigravity five-hour session and don't want to watch the clock for the next one? You can now opt into an automatic handoff from the menu. It watches fresh, real agy quota results and, only when your chosen model group has fully reset with no countdown running, launches one specified command through the local agy CLI in the background. It is off by default, will not fire again for five hours, and uses only the agy CLI on your computer. Think of a relay race: the baton moves only after the runner is back at the starting line and the clock is at zero, never early. Enabling it also shows the same Mac sleep warning as the Claude window keeper.

It is off by default, self-throttles for five hours, uses only the local agy CLI, and shows the same Mac sleep warning as the Claude window keeper when enabled.

entries: **Auto-start 5-hour Session now actually fires**: the `claude` CLI resolution list was missing `~/.local/bin/claude` (where the native installer puts it), so inside the `.app` bundle's narrow `PATH` the ping silently found nothing to run and gave up. Also hardened against a false "expired" read: the reset-time check now only trusts the live statusLine hook data source (fallback sources can default a missing `resets_at` to parse time, which the next refresh would misread as already-expired) and requires the expiry to be at least 2 minutes old before firing, filtering out that false positive without meaningfully delaying a real away-from-keyboard ping. Dialog copy from 0.28.12 also simplified — leads with "pauses on sleep, resumes on wake, nothing to manage" and routes the sleep-setting instructions through System Settings search (the exact pane/wording varies by Mac model and macOS version) with a fallback suggestion to ask Claude Code to walk through it.

title.zh-TW: 離席自動起跑，現在真的會啟動也不會誤響
title.en: Away-time auto-start now runs reliably without false alarms

body.zh-TW: 你離開電腦前開啟 Auto-start 5-hour Session（下個 5 小時階段自動啟動），它現在就會準時啟動。Mac App 的 `PATH` 很窄，找指令的名單漏掉原生安裝器放置 `claude` CLI（從終端機下指令操作 Claude 的工具）的 `~/.local/bin/claude`，背景 ping 找不到可執行項目便放棄；已補上。它也只信任 statusLine hook（會提供終端機底部狀態列資料、在特定事件觸發的小程式）的即時資料來判斷重設時間，避免備援來源把缺少的 `resets_at` 當成剛解析時間，下一次刷新又誤認額度已過期。到期滿兩分鐘才 ping，濾掉誤報，離席自動啟動不會明顯變慢。像定時洗衣機終於找得到插座，也不會把剛按下的按鈕誤當成洗完。說明視窗改成先講睡眠會暫停、醒來會恢復；睡眠設定改用 System Settings 搜尋。
body.en: Turn on Auto-start 5-hour Session before stepping away, and it will now fire on time. The Mac app's `.app` bundle has a narrow `PATH`, and its command lookup list had omitted `~/.local/bin/claude`, where the native installer puts the `claude` CLI. The background ping could find nothing to run and quietly give up; that location is now included. The reset-time check also now trusts only live statusLine hook data, supplied by a small program that is triggered by particular events and feeds the terminal's bottom status bar, rather than fallback data that can treat a missing `resets_at` value as the parsing time and later mistake it for an expired session. It waits until expiry is at least two minutes old before pinging, filtering that false alarm without meaningfully delaying a real away-time auto-start. Think of a timed washing machine that can finally find its outlet and no longer mistakes a freshly pressed button for a completed wash. The dialog now leads with the important bit: it pauses during sleep and resumes on wake. Sleep instructions send you to System Settings search, so you do not have to hunt through differently named panes on different Macs or macOS versions.

entries: **New opt-in menu toggle: Auto-start 5-hour Session.** When enabled, usage detects that your Claude 5-hour quota window has just reset and no session is currently running, then fires a single `claude -p ok --model haiku` in the background to immediately start the next window — useful if you're stepping away and want the next 5 hours counting down before you're back. Off by default; sends at most once per 5-hour window (self-throttled), never touches the Anthropic quota API, and silently no-ops if the `claude` CLI can't be found. Enabling it shows a one-time dialog explaining that it needs usage (and the Mac) to stay awake to fire — closing the lid always sleeps the Mac regardless of this setting.

title.zh-TW: 離席時，讓下一個 5 小時額度窗口先起跑
title.en: Start your next 5-hour window while you're away

body.zh-TW: 要離開電腦吃飯或出門，卻不想回來才開始等下一輪 Claude 額度嗎？usage 新增可自行開啟的「Auto-start 5-hour Session」選項。它發現 5 小時 quota window（Claude 額度每 5 小時重新計算的一段時間）剛重設、而且目前沒有執行中的 session（一次持續運作的工作階段）時，會在背景送出一次 `claude -p ok --model haiku`，立刻替下一個窗口起跑。像替洗衣機設好延後啟動：你人不在，倒數仍先開始；每個窗口最多只送一次，不會反覆叫醒它。這項功能預設關閉，不會碰 Anthropic 的 quota API（查詢額度的程式介面）；找不到 `claude` CLI（從終端機下指令操作 Claude 的工具）也會安靜略過。開啟時會先說明 usage 和 Mac 必須保持醒著，但闔上筆電仍照常讓 Mac 睡眠。
body.en: Heading out for lunch or errands and don't want your next Claude allowance window to start only when you return? usage now has an opt-in Auto-start 5-hour Session toggle. When it sees that a 5-hour quota window has reset and no session is running, it sends one background `claude -p ok --model haiku` command to start the next window immediately. Think of it like scheduling a washing machine: the countdown can begin while you're away, but it runs at most once per window rather than repeatedly nudging the machine. It is off by default, never calls Anthropic's quota API, and quietly does nothing if the `claude` CLI is unavailable. On setup, it explains that usage and your Mac need to stay awake; closing the lid still puts your Mac to sleep as usual.

entries: **The HTML usage report looks less like a template and reads more cleanly**: gold is no longer a blanket accent — it's now reserved for four focal points (headline tail, primary KPI number, the Wrapped kicker badge, the terminal cursor), with the contribution heatmap and donut chart moved to a cohesive teal/mauve palette instead. Fixed three alignment bugs: the KPI card grid now keeps a consistent rhythm across all six cards, the Wrapped section's total-token figure no longer overlaps the phoenix illustration at high digit counts, and the trailing metric card in that section no longer orphans onto its own row. Also cleans up several small "obviously AI-generated" tells: `transition: all` rules now list only the properties that actually animate, card/section borders read at a clearer contrast in both color schemes, disabled/active button states are now styled instead of falling back to defaults, motion respects `prefers-reduced-motion`, and the three share-dialog emoji icons are now matched-stroke SVGs.

title.zh-TW: 用量報表不再像套版，重點更好找也更好看
title.en: Usage reports look less templated and put the important numbers in focus

body.zh-TW: 月底打開 HTML 用量報表（可在瀏覽器看的網頁格式）時，重要數字終於不必從一片金色裡挖。金色現在只留給標題尾端、主要 KPI 數字（最關鍵的指標）、Wrapped 小標與終端機游標；貢獻熱圖和甜甜圈圖則改用一致的藍綠與藕紫。這像把舞台追光只打在主角身上，其餘演員穿協調的服裝，目光自然會落到最該看的地方。六張 KPI 卡片的排列距離已對齊，Wrapped 的總 token 數（AI 處理文字的計量單位）再長也不會壓住鳳凰插圖，最後一張指標卡也不會孤零零掉到下一列。卡片和區塊邊框在兩套配色中都更清楚；按鈕的停用、啟用狀態也更好認。動畫會尊重「減少動態效果」偏好，分享視窗三個圖示換成筆畫一致的 SVG 圖檔。連 CSS 的 `transition: all` 都改成只列會動的屬性，少掉模板常見的多餘手勢。
body.en: When you open your HTML usage report (the web-page version you view in a browser) at the end of the month, the important numbers no longer have to fight through a sea of gold. Gold is now reserved for the headline tail, main KPI number (the key performance indicator), Wrapped badge, and terminal cursor; the contribution heatmap and donut chart use a coordinated teal-and-mauve palette instead. It is like saving the spotlight for the lead actor while the rest of the cast wears matching costumes. The six KPI cards now keep even spacing, a long Wrapped total-token count no longer overlaps the phoenix, and the last metric card no longer drops onto a row by itself. Card and section borders are clearer in both color schemes, while button states are easier to recognize. Motion follows reduced-motion preferences, and the share dialog's three icons now use matching-stroke SVG artwork. Even CSS `transition: all` rules now name only properties that move, removing a telltale template habit.

Also cleans up several small "obviously AI-generated" tells: `transition: all` rules now list only the properties that actually animate, card/section borders read at a clearer contrast in both color schemes, disabled/active button states are now styled instead of falling back to defaults, motion respects `prefers-reduced-motion`, and the three share-dialog emoji icons are now matched-stroke SVGs.

entries: **Switching panels no longer stalls the UI with a beachball**: cold-rebuilding a panel view (evicted from the small LRU cache) reread and reassembled its HTML from disk every time — now the assembled markup is cached per panel and only built once. Selecting a panel no longer forces `NSUserDefaults.synchronize()` on the main thread. Unchanged panel state is no longer redundantly re-serialized and re-injected when a switch triggers two refresh passes back to back. Evicting an old cached panel view from the LRU cache is now deferred off the click's run-loop turn instead of running inline with the new panel's setup.

title.zh-TW: 切換面板不再轉彩球，畫面終於跟得上手
title.en: Panel switching no longer leaves you waiting on a spinning beachball

body.zh-TW: 你在面板間點來點去查用量時，畫面不該每次都像重新拆箱再組裝。之前若面板剛好被 LRU cache（快取，把算過的結果暫存起來直接用）擠出去，切回去得從磁碟重讀 HTML 並重組；現在每個面板組好的內容會留著，只建一次。切換時也不再讓主執行緒（專門處理你點擊與畫面的主要工作線）硬做設定同步，連著兩次刷新更不會重複打包同一份狀態。舊面板的清理改在點擊之後處理，就像店員先替你打開下一扇門，再慢慢收回前一間的展示架；換面板時終於不必盯著彩球等它回神。
body.en: When you hop between panels to check usage, the app should not unpack and rebuild a room every time. If a panel had been pushed out of the small LRU cache, switching back used to reread its HTML from disk and assemble it again. Now each panel keeps its finished markup and builds it only once. Switching also stops forcing settings synchronization on the main thread, duplicate back-to-back refreshes no longer repackage unchanged state, and cleanup of an old panel happens after your click. Like a shop attendant opening your next door before tidying the last display, rather than making you wait in the aisle.

entries: **The Claude Code statusLine hook now works end-to-end on Windows**: four fixes land together. `setup_hook` now prefers an all-ASCII `python.exe` path (falling back to system PATH when the venv path isn't ASCII), since Claude Code on Windows fails to spawn statusLine commands whose path contains non-ASCII characters; `--setup` migrates existing non-ASCII commands. All five hook scripts now read stdin via `sys.stdin.buffer` and decode UTF-8 explicitly (and the forwarder pins `encoding=utf-8` on its subprocess fan-out), since Windows otherwise decodes the piped session JSON with the locale codepage, turning a cwd like `GitHub專案` into mojibake and silently breaking `usage-status.json` writes. Hooks now fall back to `GetUserDefaultUILanguage` when no `LANG`-style env var is set (the Windows norm), matching the tray's existing language detection. `get_width()` now probes the real console width via `CONOUT$` + `GetConsoleScreenBufferInfo` instead of always falling back to a fixed 116 columns, restoring the `(left)` reset-time suffix on wide terminals. Non-Windows behavior is unchanged.

title.zh-TW: Windows 的 Claude Code 狀態列終於正常運作
title.en: Claude Code's status line finally works end-to-end on Windows

body.zh-TW: Windows 的 Claude Code 狀態列（statusLine，顯示在終端機最底下的狀態列）終於正常運作。這次修好四處：掛鉤（hook，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）優先用全 ASCII 的 Python 路徑；虛擬環境路徑不合就改用系統 PATH，`--setup` 也會遷移舊指令。五支掛鉤用 UTF-8 讀標準輸入（stdin，程式接收外來資料的入口），轉發器啟動子行程時也固定 UTF-8。Windows 不會再以系統語言的編碼頁誤解工作階段 JSON，將 `GitHub專案` 這類工作資料夾變成亂碼、寫壞 `usage-status.json`。沒有 `LANG` 類環境變數時，改查系統介面語言，和系統匣相同；主控台量實際寬度，寬終端機會重現 `(left)` 重設時間。像校正列車資訊牌的線路、語言和尺規，班次不再中途消失。非 Windows 不變。
body.en: On Windows, Claude Code's status line at the bottom of the terminal could fail somewhere along the way. This release fixes four links in that chain. Hooks (small programs triggered by particular events) now avoid Python paths containing non-ASCII characters, and `--setup` migrates older commands. All five hook scripts now read standard input as UTF-8, so a working-folder name like `GitHub專案` is no longer turned into mojibake and prevented from writing `usage-status.json`. If Windows has no `LANG`-style environment variable, the hooks now use the system UI language instead. Wide terminals also measure their actual width again, restoring the `(left)` reset-time suffix. It is like repairing the wiring, language setting, and ruler behind a train-information board so its timetable does not vanish mid-journey. Non-Windows behavior is unchanged.

All five hook scripts now read stdin via `sys.stdin.buffer` and decode UTF-8 explicitly (and the forwarder pins `encoding=utf-8` on its subprocess fan-out), since Windows otherwise decodes the piped session JSON with the locale codepage, turning a cwd like `GitHub專案` into mojibake and silently breaking `usage-status.json` writes. Hooks now fall back to `GetUserDefaultUILanguage` when no `LANG`-style env var is set (the Windows norm), matching the tray's existing language detection. `get_width()` now probes the real console width via `CONOUT$` + `GetConsoleScreenBufferInfo` instead of always falling back to a fixed 116 columns, restoring the `(left)` reset-time suffix on wide terminals. Non-Windows behavior is unchanged.

entries: **The Windows tray no longer falls back to a stale quota cache when the hook already has live data**: a complete statusLine payload from the hook could still be overridden by the `.claude.json` fallback snapshot whenever its cached timestamp looked newer, even though that cache might describe a different or expired session; the tray now always prefers a complete hook payload, and the "complete" check itself is now stricter — malformed non-numeric percentages in the hook payload no longer count as complete, so a broken payload can't silently blank the quota by skipping the cache.

**Windows tray history scanning no longer re-scans every Codex/Claude session log on each refresh tick**: `history_source_scan()` results are now cached for 30 seconds, removing the main source of UI jank in the tray.

title.zh-TW: 系統匣不被舊額度混淆，刷新歷史紀錄不再卡頓
title.en: Windows tray stops showing stale quota and speeds up history scans

body.zh-TW: 現在你可以在 Windows 系統匣中即時看到最準確的 AI 使用額度，而且檢視歷史紀錄時介面也變得滑順無比。以前當 hook（掛鉤，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）傳回全新的 statusLine（顯示在終端機最底下的狀態列）資料時，系統匣卻常被備援的舊 cache（快取，把算過或查過的結果暫存起來直接用）覆蓋，導致顯示過期或錯誤的額度；現在系統匣會優先採用最新的掛鉤資料，並嚴格把關防範錯誤格式。同時，系統匣掃描歷史工作階段的頻率也加上了 30 秒的暫存限制，免去每次重新掃描所導致的卡頓。就像看銀行的臨櫃螢幕，以前網路一抖就顯示昨天餘額，而且每次刷新都重讀交易明細害螢幕死當；現在能鎖定即時餘額，明細也改為定期刷新，省電又順暢。
body.en: You can now see your most accurate AI quota right in the Windows tray, with history scans running completely lag-free. Previously, the tray could override a fresh statusLine payload with a stale `.claude.json` fallback cache if its timestamp seemed newer, displaying outdated or expired limits; the tray now always prioritizes complete live data and rejects malformed values. Additionally, history source scanning is now cached for 30 seconds instead of checking logs on every refresh tick, eliminating UI jank. It is like a bank screen that used to show yesterday's balance on a network glitch and froze because it re-read every transaction on every refresh; it now locks onto real-time balances and updates your statement list on a smart delay.

items.original:
**The Windows tray no longer falls back to a stale quota cache when the hook already has live data**: a complete statusLine payload from the hook could still be overridden by the `.claude.json` fallback snapshot whenever its cached timestamp looked newer, even though that cache might describe a different or expired session; the tray now always prefers a complete hook payload, and the "complete" check itself is now stricter — malformed non-numeric percentages in the hook payload no longer count as complete, so a broken payload can't silently blank the quota by skipping the cache.
**Windows tray history scanning no longer re-scans every Codex/Claude session log on each refresh tick**: `history_source_scan()` results are now cached for 30 seconds, removing the main source of UI jank in the tray.

entries: **Claude quota now shows on Windows even when the statusLine hook never fires**: a Claude Code regression stops the hook from being invoked on some Windows setups, leaving the Claude quota card permanently blank. `usage_client.py` now falls back to reading `cachedUsageUtilization` straight out of Claude Code's own `~/.claude.json` when no `usage-status.json` exists, so the card still populates.

**Session hooks no longer break on non-ASCII (CJK) project paths on Windows**: the resume, terse-mode, and terse-reminder hook commands could point into the project or app-bundle source path, which failed to execute on Windows when that path contained Chinese/Japanese/Korean characters. Self-heal now normalizes these commands to their canonical `~/.claude/` targets, and the migration is idempotent — it no longer rewrites `settings.json` and appends a duplicate self-heal log entry on every restart once the command is already correct.

title.zh-TW: Windows 掛鉤與中日韓路徑修復，額度不留白、重啟不重複
title.en: Windows hooks and CJK path fixes: quotas display correctly and restarts stay clean

body.zh-TW: 現在你在 Windows 上使用中日韓字元路徑時，不用再擔心專案路徑會讓工具掛掉，或額度卡片一直顯示空白。以前有些 Windows 電腦會因為 statusLine（顯示在終端機最底下的狀態列）的 hook（掛鉤，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）沒有被正常叫起，導致額度卡片空白；現在當系統偵測不到狀態檔時，會自動採取備援（fallback）方案，直接讀取設定檔填補資訊。同時，如果你的工作階段（session）掛鉤路徑中含有中文等非英文字元，自我修復功能會自動將它們導向標準路徑，而且這個修正過程是冪等（idempotent）的，重複開機也不會多寫無用的紀錄。這就像是水管工人在裝水管時，不僅幫你把路徑上的石子清乾淨，還預備了第二條水管，就算主水管不通也能自動切換，而且水管鋪好一次就搞定，不會每次開水龍頭都重新拆裝一次。
body.en: You can now use Chinese, Japanese, or Korean characters in your project paths on Windows without fearing that tool commands will crash, or that your quota card will stay stubbornly blank. Previously on some Windows setups, the statusLine hook would fail to fire, causing the usage quota card to remain blank; now the tool automatically falls back to reading the configurations directly to populate the info. At the same time, if CJK characters in your project paths caused session hooks to error out, the self-heal process now normalizes them to their standard directory targets, and this migration is idempotent so it won't repeatedly write redundant logs on restarts. It is like a plumber who not only clears out pebbles blocking your pipe but also routes a backup water line in case the main line clogs, ensuring the faucet works smoothly and the configuration is set once and for all.

items.original:
**Claude quota now shows on Windows even when the statusLine hook never fires**: a Claude Code regression stops the hook from being invoked on some Windows setups, leaving the Claude quota card permanently blank. `usage_client.py` now falls back to reading `cachedUsageUtilization` straight out of Claude Code's own `~/.claude.json` when no `usage-status.json` exists, so the card still populates.
**Session hooks no longer break on non-ASCII (CJK) project paths on Windows**: the resume, terse-mode, and terse-reminder hook commands could point into the project or app-bundle source path, which failed to execute on Windows when that path contained Chinese/Japanese/Korean characters. Self-heal now normalizes these commands to their canonical `~/.claude/` targets, and the migration is idempotent — it no longer rewrites `settings.json` and appends a duplicate self-heal log entry on every restart once the command is already correct.

entries: **Windows hook and setup output now uses UTF-8**: statusLine bars keep their intended Unicode glyphs when Claude Code reads a pipe, and `--setup` / `--unsetup` no longer fail in legacy cp950 consoles when localized messages contain characters such as ✓.

**Windows panel controls now fit and follow the macOS grouping**: Change Panel and Hide Sections expand in place inside a scrollable menu instead of opening clipped side submenus; the panel menu now ends with only Refresh Now, avoiding duplicate update, position-reset, and quit actions.

**Windows quota-card empty areas now drag the panel rather than reorder cards**: the Windows shim temporarily marks only non-interactive card presses as native drag regions, retaining saved card order while buttons and links remain clickable.

**Windows panel switch buttons now open a focused controls menu**: clicking a panel's built-in Switch Panel button opens a localized HTML overlay for panel, visibility, refresh, notification, and workflow controls; tray-only update, position-reset, and quit actions stay out of the panel menu.

**Windows tray panels can now be repositioned**: a subtle top drag handle and quota-card empty areas move frameless panels with grab/grabbing cursors; the position is restored on the next open, clamped to the current work area, and can be reset from the tray menu.

**Windows tray menu parity for daily updates and workflow controls**: the Windows system tray now links to AI Update Daily, offers a Hide Sections submenu for Claude, Codex, and Antigravity, supports quota-alert notifications at the same thresholds as macOS, and exposes Resume Last Session and Token Saver toggles. Changes to visible sections are injected into an open panel immediately; quota alerts use native Windows tray notifications. The macOS-only AI Talent Market remains unavailable on Windows.

title.zh-TW: Windows 控制台不再亂碼，進度條與設定順利顯示
title.en: Windows console stops showing gibberish, progress bars and setup output display perfectly

body.zh-TW: 在老舊的 Windows 控制台裡執行指令時，你不會再被莫名其妙的亂碼或錯誤中斷了。以前在傳統的 cp950（繁體中文的舊編碼）控制台環境下，跑 `--setup` 和 `--unsetup` 時若遇到像「✓」這樣的在地化符號，系統會因為讀不懂這些 Unicode（萬國碼）字元而直接失敗中斷。現在這些 hook（用來攔截並回報狀態的隱藏外掛）與設定輸出都全面改用 UTF-8（現代通用編碼），因此 `--setup` 系列指令不再報錯，而且當 Claude Code 從 pipe（用來傳遞資料的通道）讀取時，statusLine（顯示在最底下的狀態列）進度條也能順利保留原本的圖形字元。就像你拿著一本現代的表情符號字典去給只懂古文的老爺爺看，以前他會直接罷工，現在系統幫你請了個翻譯，爺爺也能看懂並笑著幫你辦事了。
body.en: You will no longer be interrupted by bizarre gibberish errors when running commands in legacy Windows consoles. Previously, in traditional cp950 (legacy text encoding) console environments, encountering localized symbols like "✓" during `--setup` and `--unsetup` would cause the system to fail because it couldn't understand those Unicode (universal character standard) characters. Now, these hooks (hidden plugins used to intercept and report status) and setup outputs strictly use UTF-8 (modern text encoding). As a result, setup commands no longer fail, and when Claude Code reads a pipe for the statusLine (the progress bar at the bottom), it successfully keeps its intended glyphs. It's like handing a modern emoji dictionary to a grandfather who only reads ancient text; he used to just walk away, but now the system provides a translator so he can understand and happily do his job.

items.original: **Windows hook and setup output now uses UTF-8**: statusLine bars keep their intended Unicode glyphs when Claude Code reads a pipe, and `--setup` / `--unsetup` no longer fail in legacy cp950 consoles when localized messages contain characters such as ✓.

title.zh-TW: Windows 選單介面大翻新，操作對齊 macOS 且不再被裁切
title.en: Windows menus get a massive overhaul, aligning with macOS and fixing clipped screens

body.zh-TW: Windows 用戶現在點開系統匣或面板選單，不會再找不到按鈕了。以前面板的子選單常被視窗邊緣裁切掉；現在「更換面板」與「隱藏區塊」等選項會直接在可捲動的選單裡原地展開。Windows 的日常更新與工作流程控制也跟上 macOS：面板內建按鈕會彈出在地化的 HTML（網頁標記語言）覆蓋層提供各項控制，系統匣選單補齊 AI 更新日報、Claude、Codex 與 Antigravity 的「隱藏區塊」子選單，加上「接著上次做」與「省 token（AI 處理與計費單位）模式」開關。可見區塊的變更立刻套用，額度提醒也在相同門檻發出 Windows 原生通知。面板選單底部也不再重複列更新、位置重設和退出。就像重新裝潢的中控室：以前螢幕太小、按鈕被切掉按不到；現在換上能捲動的大螢幕，隔壁蘋果部門的好用按鈕也搬齊了。（macOS 限定的 AI 人才市場，Windows 仍不提供。）
body.en: Windows users clicking the system tray or panel menus will now find these features neatly organized and easy to access. Previously, opening panel control submenus on Windows would often cause them to get ruthlessly clipped by the window edge; now, options like Change Panel and Hide Sections expand securely inside a scrollable menu. Furthermore, the Windows interface has reached parity with macOS for daily updates and workflow controls: the built-in panel buttons now launch a localized HTML (web markup language) overlay for controls, and the system tray menu features the AI Update Daily, a Hide Sections submenu for Claude, Codex, and Antigravity, and toggles for Resume Last Session and Token Saver (a mode to save AI processing units). Visibility changes apply instantly to the open panel, and quota alerts correctly use native Windows notifications at the same thresholds as macOS. The panel menu no longer clutters its bottom with duplicate update, position-reset, and quit actions. It's like a newly renovated control room: previously, the screens were so small that some buttons got chopped off, and you lacked some tools the Apple team had. Now you have a scrolling monitor with these workflow buttons brought over and neatly arranged. (Note: the macOS-only AI Talent Market remains unavailable on Windows).

**Windows tray menu parity for daily updates and workflow controls**: the Windows system tray now links to AI Update Daily, offers a Hide Sections submenu for Claude, Codex, and Antigravity, supports quota-alert notifications at the same thresholds as macOS, and exposes Resume Last Session and Token Saver toggles. Changes to visible sections are injected into an open panel immediately; quota alerts use native Windows tray notifications. The macOS-only AI Talent Market remains unavailable on Windows.

title.zh-TW: Windows 面板支援自由拖曳，再也不會誤觸卡片排序
title.en: Windows panels are now freely draggable without messing up card orders

body.zh-TW: 你現在可以隨心所欲地在螢幕上拖動 Windows 的系統匣面板了。只要按住無邊框面板頂端不顯眼的把手，或是額度卡片的空白處，游標就會變成抓取的圖示，讓你輕鬆移動視窗；系統也會記住你放的位置，下次打開還在原地，並確保它不會跑出螢幕外。更棒的是，以前在額度卡片空白處按壓可能會不小心觸發重新排列卡片的功能，現在 Windows 墊片（shim，用來轉換不同系統行為的中介層）會暫時把這些非互動區域標記為純拖曳區。這表示你可以放心用它來移動整個面板，不會打亂你原本排好的卡片順序，而卡片上的按鈕和連結依然可以正常點擊。就像一張原本黏死在桌布上的佈告欄，現在不只裝了滑輪讓你隨意推動，而且你推著板子邊緣時，也不用怕不小心把上面的便利貼給撕下來。
body.en: You can now freely drag the Windows system tray panels around your screen. By grabbing the subtle handle at the top of the frameless panel or clicking the empty areas of the quota card, your cursor turns into a grabbing hand, letting you move the window with ease. The system remembers where you put it for the next time, clamping it safely within your active workspace. Even better, pressing empty areas of the quota card used to accidentally trigger card reordering, but now the Windows shim (a compatibility layer bridging different system behaviors) temporarily designates these non-interactive zones exclusively for dragging. This means you can comfortably move the entire panel without scrambling your perfectly organized cards, while all buttons and links remain fully clickable. It's like a corkboard that used to be nailed to the wall—now it has wheels so you can roll it anywhere, and when you push the edges to move it, you no longer have to worry about accidentally knocking all the sticky notes off.

items.original:
**Windows quota-card empty areas now drag the panel rather than reorder cards**: the Windows shim temporarily marks only non-interactive card presses as native drag regions, retaining saved card order while buttons and links remain clickable.
**Windows tray panels can now be repositioned**: a subtle top drag handle and quota-card empty areas move frameless panels with grab/grabbing cursors; the position is restored on the next open, clamped to the current work area, and can be reset from the tray menu.

entries: **The Claude quota card now explains why it shows no data for desktop-app/headless-only users**: the quota card depends entirely on the statusLine hook, which Claude Code only invokes when rendering an interactive terminal. Users whose usage happens exclusively through the desktop app or other non-TUI surfaces never trigger it, so the card stayed on a generic "status file not found" message even while the hook was correctly installed and Claude Code transcripts kept growing. The card now distinguishes this case — hook installed, transcripts actively updating, status file still missing — and shows a targeted hint that a terminal session needs to run once to sync, instead of the setup-focused message meant for users who never installed the hook at all.

title.zh-TW: 配額卡片更聰明，桌面版用戶不再滿頭問號
title.en: Quota card gets smarter, ending confusion for desktop app users

body.zh-TW: 那些只用桌面版的人，不會再對著沒有數字的 Claude 配額卡片發愣，懷疑自己是不是沒裝好了。配額卡片背後仰賴的是 statusLine hook（一種用來攔截並回報狀態的隱藏小程式），但 Claude Code 只有在你打開互動式終端機時才會叫醒它。以前如果你只用桌面版，這個 hook 永遠不會被觸發，就算你的對話紀錄明明一直在增加，卡片還是只會死板地說「找不到狀態檔」，甚至叫你重新安裝。現在卡片會分辨情況了：如果它發現你明明有裝 hook 也有在聊天，只是缺了狀態檔，它會明確告訴你「需要開一次終端機工作階段來同步」，而不是丟給你根本不適用的安裝教學。就像你裝了智慧電表，但都在用別的插座，電表沒感應到；以前它只會叫你把電表拆掉重裝，現在它會告訴你「去插一下這個專用插座同步數據就好」。
body.en: People who exclusively use the desktop app will no longer stare at a blank Claude quota card wondering if they botched the installation. The quota card relies heavily on the statusLine hook (a hidden mini-program that intercepts and reports status), but Claude Code only wakes it up when you open an interactive terminal. Previously, if you only used the desktop version, this hook was never triggered. Even if your transcripts were actively growing, the card stubbornly displayed a generic "status file not found" message and told you to run the setup again. Now, the card recognizes when the hook is installed and you're actively chatting, but the status file is just missing. Instead of giving you irrelevant installation instructions, it gives you a targeted hint that a terminal session needs to run once to sync. It's like installing a smart water meter but using a different sink; previously the meter would tell you to rip it out and reinstall it, but now it just tells you to "go turn on the main faucet once to sync the data."

Users whose usage happens exclusively through the desktop app or other non-TUI surfaces never trigger it, so the card stayed on a generic "status file not found" message even while the hook was correctly installed and Claude Code transcripts kept growing. The card now distinguishes this case — hook installed, transcripts actively updating, status file still missing — and shows a targeted hint that a terminal session needs to run once to sync, instead of the setup-focused message meant for users who never installed the hook at all.
